Drawing language of contemporary independent illustration posters: bold flat silhouettes, a few confident cut lines inside the shapes that reveal the burgundy paper, each cut line at least as thick as a pencil stroke; wild, expressive, slightly menacing creatures with dynamic twisted bodies, sharp and adult, with dry humour. The card carries no lettering. Relationship and composition: heraldic mirror symmetry along the vertical axis: two salmon in white arch outward forming a lyre shape on the lower two thirds; a single silver lamb stands frontally between their curved bodies at the top, rearing, its legs hooked over the fish. Strong ornamental silhouette with bold internal cuts.
